dogecoin.text: Dogecoin (DOGE) is a peer-to-peer, open-source cryptocurrency established in 2013. Originally created as somewhat of a joke about cryptocurrency, the token became fairly popular with the image of a Shiba Inu dog named Kabosu as its logo. $LAIKA @Laika_Layer2
